headerDisplay: Opens a Tuya Gate Camera / video intercom from HomeKit by pulsing accessory_lock (DP 148). By default Home only shows a Lock (Unlock = open). Optionally add a momentary Switch for the same action.
footerDisplay: Tip: Keep “Show open switch” off for a cleaner Home screen. Turn it on if you prefer a switch tile for automations. Both controls send the same Tuya open command.

name.title: Name in Home
name.description: Label for the lock (and optional switch) in the Home app.

accessId.title: Access ID / Client ID
accessId.description: From Tuya IoT project Overview (Access ID / Client ID).

accessSecret.title: Access Secret / Client Secret
accessSecret.description: From Tuya IoT project Overview. Keep this private.

deviceId.title: Device ID
deviceId.description: Gate Camera device id, e.g. bf3f24408fb356db59qioh

region.title: Data center
region.description: Must match the cloud project data center.

lockCode.title: Lock DP code
lockCode.description: Tuya property code for the gate open pulse. Default accessory_lock (DP 148). Use ipc_c_lock for a second lock channel if needed.

showSwitch.title: Show open switch
showSwitch.description: Off (default): only a Lock in Home — Unlock opens the gate. On: also add a momentary Switch that does the same open pulse (useful for some automations).
